title: The evening, everyone at once
problem: The evening goes stall by stall; each stall waits its turn to build, and a solo player watches every computer's turn first.
scope: Every stall decides its evening at the same time and says when it is done; night falls when all are done
Priority settled at nightfall by today's line-up; the other cards return to their hands
Online rooms, takeover and reconnect; pass-and-play hand-over; the evening screens and beats; RULES.md and the Priority card text

acceptance.text: Tests: any order; night only when all are done; Priority by line-up with the others returned; computer-only evening ends at once; pass-and-play; online two people at once and a takeover
Seen by me in a solo game and an online game at 390x844 and 360x640

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13, in his own words: "also make so that each player access and build the upgrade together rather than waiting player by player".
